title: Add error handling to FileMemoryStore.Load and FileEventStore.GetEvents
description: FileMemoryStore.Load calls File.ReadAllText then JsonSerializer.Deserialize with zero error handling — a single corrupt record file crashes the caller (LoadAll handles this gracefully but Load does not). FileEventStore.GetEvents has two silent catch blocks: inner skips malformed JSON lines, outer swallows I/O failures returning empty results indistinguishable from no events. Fix: add try/catch in Load matching LoadAll's diagnostic recording pattern; add logging to both FileEventStore catch blocks. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P2-029/030

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Approved for Wave 1, execution order 05 of 09. Storage read failures should be diagnosable and bounded rather than appearing as crashes or empty data.
